description: **The cap fails open if `claude agents` drops `pid` or `kind`**: add a check that warns when no background row has a pid while some are `working`. A per-row "a `working` row with no pid warns" would fire on every launch (see the row above). Why: `state` has already changed shape once; with no pid nothing counts, so nothing is refused and no one is told. Raised: W41 report open question 2; W41 review round 1, Later 2, 2026-11-06
title: The cap fails open if `claude agents` drops `pid` or `kind`
